Seven merged pull requests since 2026-04-14 added or removed a line containing `hasPrivilege` under `api/src/main/java/org/openmrs`. All seven are on the main line up to the head, `5eb8cba` (master HEAD). Merge dates are UTC, from the stored PR copies.

| PR | Merged | Merge commit | What changed |
|---|---|---|---|
| #6383 (TRUNK-6712) | 2026-07-24 | `1b5421a` | `UserContext` rewrote the `hasPrivilege` logic and added `hasPrivilege(String, boolean)`. `Context` gained the same overload. `AdministrationServiceImpl` switched four `Context.getAuthenticatedUser().hasPrivilege(...)` calls to `Context.hasPrivilege(..., false)`. |
| #6544 (TRUNK-6799) | 2026-10-08 | `a69b14a` | New security files added lines with `hasPrivilege`: `OpenmrsAuthenticationToken`, `OpenmrsAuthorizationManagerFactory`, `OpenmrsPermissionEvaluator`, `OpenmrsSecurityConfig`, and `RolePrivileges` (javadoc). |
| #6668 (TRUNK-6802) | 2026-10-13 | `cb6cda4` | `PrivilegeResolution` added `Context.hasPrivilege(privilege)`. `LegacyContextAuthentication` added javadoc lines. `OpenmrsPermissionEvaluator` removed `if (Context.hasPrivilege(privilege))`. |
| #6598 (TRUNK-6707) | 2026-10-01 | `07e8ea0` | `AdministrationServiceImpl` added `checkCanView` with `Context.hasPrivilege(gp.getViewPrivilege(), false)`. |
| #6233 (porting TRUNK-6429/6515) | 2026-07-01 | `c4aca3a` | `JobRunrSchedulerService` removed `isSchedulerManager(User)`, which called `user.hasPrivilege(...)`, and added `Context.hasPrivilege(MANAGE_SCHEDULER)` calls. |
| #6186 (TRUNK-6xxx, Get Alerts) | 2026-06-18 | `f5c0350` | `AlertServiceImpl.canViewAllAlerts` added `Context.hasPrivilege(PrivilegeConstants.GET_ALERTS)`. |
| #6674 (TRUNK-6823) | 2026-10-13 | `5eb8cba` | Only a javadoc line in `OpenmrsAuthorizationManagerFactory` changed, from `Context.hasPrivilege` wording in the short-circuit sentence. |

I got these by diffing each file that currently contains `hasPrivilege` against the commits that touched it since 2026-04-14. The main limit is that I did not diff every file the later PRs touched. Lines removed from files that no longer contain `hasPrivilege` could still be missed. Two commits with no PR number, `3310bc1` and `fc64842` (the 2026-04-14 boundary commit), were not counted as PRs. `3310bc1` showed no `hasPrivilege` changes in the files I checked.
